title: Highly connected counterexamples to the permutation Tutte inequality
summary: We disprove Conjecture 7.3 of Csikvári, Around the Merino–Welsh conjecture: improving Jackson's inequality, which asserts that $\widetilde T_H(2,0)\widetilde T_H(0,2)\ge1$ for every bipartite graph $H$ of minimum degree at least two. For each integer $k\ge2$, we construct an explicit sequence of finite simple balanced bipartite graphs whose minimum degree and vertex connectivity are both exactly $k$.
